name: Phan Thiết

queries.query: Phan Thiết cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry Vietnam
queries.result: Official GDLA map infrastructure was found. Official Bình Thuận/Phan Thiết material also names the local land-registration branch and cadastral map extracts, but no anonymous parcel feature was obtained.

queries.query: Phan Thiết bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức
queries.result: Official local documents identify Chi nhánh Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai Phan Thiết as producing cadastral extracts and refer to parcel and map-sheet identities. No public anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and Vietnamese discovery plus bounded anonymous official viewer/API inspection
sourceReview: Local custody is evidenced by official Bình Thuận and Phan Thiết administration documents naming Chi nhánh Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai Phan Thiết and referring to cadastral extracts. The GDLA national map viewer exposed the current public shell and configuration, but the cadastral vector-tile and feature-detail routes returned authentication-required responses. General national GDLA map infrastructure is not treated as local city integration by itself.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Current official GDLA map viewer shell loaded; JavaScript bundle was inspected.
Current viewer configuration loaded. It identified the dia-chinh layer field names and the vector tile route /tiles/vector-views-tiles/dia-chinh/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt; no parcel records were returned.
Public map display configuration loaded; it confirmed a dia-chinh layer exists but did not provide parcel features or CRS for a parcel response.
Returned public-region parameters for the 2025 national statistics context; this is not a parcel feature response.
Cadastral vector tile request returned Vietnamese authentication-required JSON. No login, credentials, token reuse, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS bypass was attempted.
Bounded anonymous detail-route probe was authentication-required; no feature schema, native ID, geometry, or attributes obtained.

Official Bình Thuận document states a cadastral extract was prepared by Chi nhánh Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai Phan Thiết and identifies a parcel/map-sheet example; no reusable safe polygon was retained.
Official Bình Thuận document independently names the Phan Thiết land-registration branch and cadastral extract workflow; no reusable safe polygon was retained.
Official Phan Thiết administration page exposed land-use planning documents, not a cadastral parcel API or safe parcel geometry.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: https://maps.gdla.gov.vn/api/config exposed dia-chinh display fields including mathuadat, maxa, sohieutobando, sothututhua, maloaidat, and geometry-adjacent metadata, but no successful feature response.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not observed for a successful Phan Thiết parcel response.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed in a parcel feature response; no synthetic identity created.

sourceFieldMapping.mathuadat: native parcel code (viewer-configured field; not returned for a feature)
sourceFieldMapping.maxa: commune code (viewer-configured field; not returned for a feature)
sourceFieldMapping.sohieutobando: map-sheet number (viewer-configured field; not returned for a feature)
sourceFieldMapping.sothututhua: parcel sequence number (viewer-configured field; not returned for a feature)

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Not qualified; official documents mention parcel/map-sheet combinations, but no machine-readable feature response was obtained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point [10.9387991301736,108.102311687381] was preserved; no coordinate shift or exact-point parcel query was used.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: Authentication wall on cadastral routes; no exact-point hit or miss and no citywide absence inferred.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if later source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry if later exposed

qualification.reason: Local cadastral custody is evidenced, but anonymous parcel geometry, native identity, CRS, and citywide open coverage were not qualified.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
A 401/authentication wall, lack of feature response, or unusable route was not treated as citywide cadastral absence.
Citywide completeness, update cadence, parcel CRS, and stable identity semantics remain unverified.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: Phan Thiết local cadastral custodianship is supported by official provincial/city documents. Current public anonymous parcel access is blocked by authentication on the official GDLA cadastral routes; a future authenticated or different public route may expose safe geometry. Runtime/admission remains held.
